SELECT emp21_un_leave_id, emp21_company_id, emp21_person_id, emp21_un_leave_cd, emp21_start_date, emp21_total_days, emp21_use_days, emp21_remain_days, emp21_appr_id, emp21_expect_appr_id , f_emp_kor_nm(emp21_person_id) AS emp21_person_nm , emp01_emp_no AS emp21_person_no , COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date) AS emp21_hire_date , f_cdnm('unLeaveCode', emp21_un_leave_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp21_un_leave_nm , apr01.apr01_reg_date AS emp21_notice_date , apr01.apr01_status_cd AS emp21_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01.apr01_status_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp21_appr_status_nm , apr02.apr01_status_cd AS emp21_expect_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr02.apr01_status_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp21_expect_appr_status_nm
, f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '1') - INTERVAL '1 years' AS emp21_leave_occur_start_date , f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') - INTERVAL '1 years' AS emp21_leave_occur_close_date , f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '1') AS emp21_leave_target_start_date , f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') AS emp21_leave_target_close_date , sys01_company_nm AS emp21_company_nm , sys01_leave_compulsion_rt AS emp21_duty_rt , f_get_emptrans(emp21_person_id, emp21_start_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS emp21_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp21_person_id, emp21_start_date::date, 'pos_nm') AS emp21_pos_nm FROM emp21_un_leave INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp21_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp21_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp21_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr01 ON apr01.apr01_appr_id = emp21_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr02 ON apr02.apr01_appr_id = emp21_expect_appr_id WHERE emp21_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp21_un_leave_cd LIKE #{unLeaveCode} AND emp21_start_date BETWEEN f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '1') AND f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear},'2') ORDER BY emp01_emp_no

SELECT emp21_un_leave_id, emp21_company_id, emp21_person_id, emp21_un_leave_cd, emp21_start_date, emp21_total_days, emp21_use_days, emp21_remain_days, emp21_appr_id, emp21_expect_appr_id , f_emp_kor_nm(emp21_person_id) AS emp21_person_nm , emp01_emp_no AS emp21_person_no , COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date) AS emp21_hire_date , f_cdnm('unLeaveCode', emp21_un_leave_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp21_un_leave_nm , apr01.apr01_reg_date AS emp21_notice_date , apr01.apr01_status_cd AS emp21_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01.apr01_status_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp21_appr_status_nm , apr02.apr01_status_cd AS emp21_expect_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr02.apr01_status_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp21_expect_appr_status_nm , sys01_company_nm AS emp21_company_nm , sys01_leave_compulsion_rt AS emp21_duty_rt , f_get_emptrans(emp21_person_id, emp21_start_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS emp21_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp21_person_id, emp21_start_date::date, 'pos_nm') AS emp21_pos_nm , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('03','04') THEN COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date) WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('05','06') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+10month' END AS emp21_leave_occur_start_date , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('03','04') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+10month -1day' WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('05','06') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+12month -1day' END AS emp21_leave_occur_close_date , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('03','04') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+1month' WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('05','06') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+10month' END AS emp21_leave_target_start_date , date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+12month -1day' AS emp21_leave_target_close_date FROM emp21_un_leave INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp21_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp21_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp21_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr01 ON apr01.apr01_appr_id = emp21_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr02 ON apr02.apr01_appr_id = emp21_expect_appr_id WHERE emp21_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp21_un_leave_cd LIKE #{unLeaveCode} AND emp21_un_leave_cd NOT IN ('01','02') AND to_char(emp21_start_date,'yyyy') = #{stdYear} ORDER BY emp01_emp_no

WITH emp01 AS ( SELECT emp01_person.* , f_get_datediff(COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date), (f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, #{stdYear}, '2') + INTERVAL '-1year')::date, '1') AS emp20_year_period , CASE WHEN (f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, #{stdYear}, '1') - COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, #{stdYear}, '1') - COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) / 365.0, 2) END AS emp20_year_per , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id, #{stdYear}, '4', std_date, 'true') AS emp20_year_leave_days , CASE WHEN (f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, #{stdYear}, '1') - COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) > 0 THEN '' ELSE f_get_datediff(COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date), std_date, '1') END AS emp20_month_period , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id, #{stdYear}, '5', std_date, 'true') AS emp20_month_leave_days , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id, #{stdYear}, '2', std_date, 'true') AS emp20_use_days_calc , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id, #{stdYear}, '6', std_date, 'true') AS emp20_spc_days , std_date FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id , ( SELECT CASE WHEN #{unLeaveCode} = '01' THEN cast(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear},'2') - INTERVAL '6 months' as date) ELSE cast(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear},'2') - INTERVAL '2 months' as date) END std_date ) t WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= f_today() ) AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800', '900') /*(800:겸직/900:퇴직)*/ AND emp03_title_cd != '900' /*(900:비상근)*/ AND COALESCE(emp03_non_stay_yn,'false') != 'true' AND emp03_kind_cd NOT IN ('40','99') /*(40:임시직/99:기타직)*/ ) SELECT a.* , emp20_total_days - emp20_use_days AS emp20_remain_days FROM ( SELECT emp01.* , emp20_year_leave_days AS emp20_total_days , CASE WHEN emp20_month_leave_days >= emp20_use_days_calc THEN 0 ELSE emp20_use_days_calc - emp20_month_leave_days END AS emp20_use_days FROM emp01 ) a WHERE 1=1 AND f_today() BETWEEN std_date+1 AND std_date+10 AND emp01_person_id NOT IN ( SELECT e.emp21_person_id FROM emp21_un_leave e WHERE e.emp21_person_id = emp01_person_id AND e.emp21_un_leave_cd = #{unLeaveCode} AND e.emp21_start_date BETWEEN std_date+1 AND std_date+10 ) AND emp20_total_days - emp20_use_days > 0 AND ( ( #{unLeaveCode} = '02' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp21_un_leave INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON ( apr01_appr_id = emp21_expect_appr_id AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') ) WHERE emp21_person_id = emp01_person_id AND TO_CHAR(emp21_start_date,'yyyy') = #{stdYear} AND emp21_un_leave_cd = '01' ) ) OR ( #{unLeaveCode} != '02' ) ) ORDER BY emp01_emp_no

WITH emp AS ( SELECT emp01_person.* , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id, #{stdYear}, '2', f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, #{stdYear},'2'), 'true') + CASE WHEN #{stdYear} = to_char(COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date),'YYYY') THEN 0 ELSE f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id, to_char(COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date),'YYYY'), '2', f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, to_char(COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date),'YYYY'),'2'), 'true') END AS use_month_days , COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date) AS calc_hire_date FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date) + interval '+1year' > f_today() AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= f_today() ) AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800', '900') /*(800:겸직/900:퇴직)*/ AND emp03_title_cd != '900' /*(900:비상근)*/ AND COALESCE(emp03_non_stay_yn,'false') != 'true' AND emp03_kind_cd NOT IN ('40','99') /*(40:임시직/99:기타직)*/ ) SELECT row_number() over() AS emp01_person_id , un_leave_code AS emp01_un_leave_code , f_emp_kor_nm(emp01_person_id) AS emp21_person_nm , emp01_emp_no AS emp21_person_no , f_get_emptrans(emp01_person_id, f_today(), 'pos_nm') AS emp21_pos_nm , f_get_emptrans(emp01_person_id, f_today(), 'org_code_nm') AS emp21_org_nm , calc_hire_date AS emp21_hire_date , occur_start_date AS emp21_leave_occur_start_date , occur_close_date AS emp21_leave_occur_close_date , use_start_date AS emp21_leave_target_start_date , use_close_date AS emp21_leave_target_close_date , occur_days AS emp21_total_days , use_days AS emp21_use_days , occur_days - use_days AS emp21_remain_days , sys01_leave_compulsion_rt AS emp21_duty_rt , occur_days AS emp20_total_days , use_days AS emp20_use_days , occur_days - use_days AS emp20_remain_days , emp01_person_id AS emp20_person_id , a.* FROM ( SELECT '03' un_leave_code , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+9month' notice_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+9month +9day' notice_close_date --, date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+1month' occur_start_date , calc_hire_date occur_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+10month -1day' occur_close_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+1month' use_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+12month -1day' use_close_date , 9 occur_days , use_month_days use_days , calc_hire_date calc_hire_date , emp01_person_id person_id FROM emp UNION SELECT '05' un_leave_code , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+11month' notice_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+11month +4day' notice_close_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+10month' occur_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+12month -1day' occur_close_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+10month' use_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+12month -1day' use_close_date , 2 occur_days , greatest(use_month_days-9,0) use_days , calc_hire_date calc_hire_date , emp01_person_id person_id FROM emp UNION SELECT '04' un_leave_code , f_get_last_day((date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+10month')::date) + interval '-4day' notice_start_date , f_get_last_day((date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+10month')::date) notice_close_date --, date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+1month' occur_start_date , calc_hire_date occur_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+10month -1day' occur_close_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+1month' use_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+12month -1day' use_close_date , 9 occur_days , use_month_days use_days , calc_hire_date calc_hire_date , emp01_person_id person_id FROM emp UNION SELECT '06' un_leave_code , f_get_last_day((date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+11month')::date) + interval '-14day' notice_start_date , f_get_last_day((date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+11month')::date) + interval '-10day' notice_close_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+10month' occur_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+12month -1day' occur_close_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+10month' use_start_date , date_trunc('month', calc_hire_date) + interval '+12month -1day' use_close_date , 2 occur_days , greatest(use_month_days-9,0) use_days , calc_hire_date calc_hire_date , emp01_person_id person_id FROM emp ) t INNER JOIN emp01_person a ON emp01_person_id = person_id , sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId} AND f_today() BETWEEN notice_start_date AND notice_close_date AND occur_days - use_days > 0 AND ( (un_leave_code IN ('04','06') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp21_un_leave INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp21_expect_appr_id WHERE emp21_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp21_un_leave_cd = CASE WHEN un_leave_code = '04' THEN '03' ELSE '05' END AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('99','40') ) ) OR (un_leave_code NOT IN ('04','06')) ) AND emp01_person_id NOT IN ( SELECT emp21_person_id FROM emp21_un_leave WHERE emp21_person_id = person_id AND emp21_un_leave_cd = un_leave_code AND emp21_start_date BETWEEN notice_start_date AND notice_close_date ) ORDER BY notice_start_date, emp01_emp_no

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp21_un_leave ( emp21_un_leave_id, emp21_company_id, emp21_person_id, emp21_un_leave_cd, emp21_start_date , emp21_total_days, emp21_use_days, emp21_remain_days ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, t.emp01_person_id, #{unLeaveCode}, f_today() , t.emp20_total_days, t.emp20_use_days, t.emp20_remain_days FROM () t
